game.label: Your dumped P.T. game folder (CUSA01127, the US release) with chunk1.psarc and texture.qar in it. A fake PKG has to be extracted first.

settings.label: Graphics API
settings.help: Vulkan runs everywhere. DirectX 12 is Windows only and is needed for DLSS Frame Generation. Game's option uses your pt.ini.

settings.label: V-Sync
settings.help: Off shows each frame as soon as it is finished, which can tear. Game's option uses your pt.ini.

settings.label: Button prompts
settings.help: Which controller buttons the game shows. Game's option follows the last device you used.

settings.label: VR
settings.help: The experimental VR mode needs an OpenXR runtime and a headset. Off ignores a VR setting in pt.ini.

settings.label: In-game update check
settings.help: RecompLauncher already updates the game. Off stops the game from also looking for a new release.

actions.label: Saves and settings
actions.help: Your save, pt.ini and the log.
